recovery_granularity: complete native epoch; an interrupted partial epoch is not silently counted

native_session_metadata.batch_collation: native PyG Batch.from_data_list, batch32, full features

boundary.first_R: one isolated CPU generator, field-order Rademacher tables
boundary.native_BN_policy: same shared original buffers; native forward once per route

context_affinity.assignment: routes0/1 qA, routes2/3 qB; no assignment search
context_affinity.auxiliary_reduction: mean supported anchors within observed class, then mean over supported classes, then mean members
context_affinity.context_A: concatenated per-field native atom-category frequency histograms
context_affinity.context_B: concatenated per-field native directed bond-category frequency histograms; edgeless zero vector
context_affinity.context_construction: canonical CPU FP32 using every actual native batch record; no native feature/edge changes
context_affinity.gradient_support: live native graph preheads; no direct auxiliary path to final output bank
context_affinity.inference: unchanged mean native raw logits; no factual context input at serving
context_affinity.missing_labels: excluded from auxiliary only; original source BCE mask unchanged
context_affinity.source_bn_policy: unchanged shared native buffers with sequential route forwards
context_affinity.target: detached cosine/.2 softmax over distinct same observed TRAIN class donors; no same-object donor
context_affinity.update: original full native observed-label mixed-batch BCE member mean F+.05A, one all-block backward and original Adam step
context_affinity.vocab_source: num_embeddings in actual native AtomEncoder and every layer's BondEncoder; all source bond vocabularies equal
context_affinity.zero_contexts: uniform target when zero; zero contexts and unsupported anchors explicitly reported

native_session_metadata.global_RNG: controller-owned; factory does not reseed it
native_session_metadata.input_encoding: all native categorical atom fields; no IDs changed
native_session_metadata.optimizer: native torch.optim.Adam lr=.001, original defaults, no explicit loss regularizer
native_session_metadata.sampler: native RandomSampler without replacement, private persisted generator/order/cursor

normalization_bank_state.resident_native_buffers: original objects and initial state outside route
normalization_bank_state.state_access: TRAIN updates its own route; eval reads it without recalibration

source_metadata.sampler: native PyG DataLoader RandomSampler, complete epoch; no next-epoch crossover
source_metadata.source_track_fidelity: declared matched training controller; not paper-equivalent
